definitions.gloss: sunlight, sunshine, rays of the sun
definitions.explanation: The light and warmth from the sun, especially when perceived as direct beams.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧{日差|ひざ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧。
examples.english: The soft spring sunlight feels nice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{日差|ひざ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶった→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧。
examples.english: I wore a hat to avoid the strong sunlight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{日差|ひざ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}んでいる→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧。
examples.english: Sunlight is streaming in through the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧{日差|ひざ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びて→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}した→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk basking in the warm sunlight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日差|ひざ}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: Summer sunlight is harsh on the skin.

notes:
{日差|ひざ}し is sunlight as you feel it — its strength, warmth, and angle — rather than sunlight as a physical phenomenon. It is the word weather reports and everyday conversation use.

ALTERNATE SPELLINGS:
- {日射|ひざ}し and {陽射|ひざ}し are the same word; {日差|ひざ}し is the most common spelling.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日差|ひざ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (the sun is strong)
- {日差|ひざ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧ (the sunlight is soft)
- {日差|ひざ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧ (to bask in the sun)
- {日差|ひざ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}む→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧ (sunlight streams in)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧ - the sun itself, the celestial body
- ⟦{日光|にっこう}→日光：03515_nikkou⟧ - sunlight in a neutral or technical sense (sunlight exposure, photosynthesis)
- ⟦{陽光|ようこう}→陽光：09669_youkou⟧ - sunlight in literary or descriptive writing
